postconditions.description: the current branch is now at the upstream branch tip

postconditions.description: the working tree again shows the uncommitted changes the user asked to keep

preconditions.description: there is uncommitted work (tracked modifications or untracked files) that must survive the update

preconditions.description: HEAD is an ancestor of, and not equal to, the upstream branch tip, so a fast-forward merge is possible

[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" != "$(git rev-parse {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch})" ]
